text: This solution, Inclusive insurance and risk financing in Pakistan. Snapshot and way forward 2024 addresses natural catastrophe in Pakistan between UNDP Country Offices, United Nations Development Programme’s Insurance and Risk Finance Facility (UNDP IRFF), and German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
